notes.unit: One row is a corridor: contiguous segments sharing a street name and a recommended intervention. Not one OSM way - the median recommended way here is 119m and 57% are unnamed.
notes.suitability_after: Null wherever benefit_kind is 'not_modelled'. The traffic-stress score has no input representing a crossing treatment or bike parking, so no before/after is computed for those rather than borrowing another intervention's number. Render as N/A, never as a guess.
notes.context_hex_fields: Properties of the ~0.1km2 hex the corridor sits in, computed from hex-level population - not savings attributable to fixing this corridor. Two corridors crossing the same cell carry the same figures. Label as context in any UI.
notes.estimated_beneficiaries: Residents within 500m of the whole corridor, from a single unioned buffer - never the sum of its segments' own values, whose buffers overlap almost entirely.
notes.signalised_junctions: A count of OSM signal nodes near the member ways. OSM tags signals per approach, so this over-counts real junctions ~1.6x. Usable as a relative sort key, wrong as 'this project treats N junctions'.
